status: Prospective plan for the corrected successor to blocked Ohm Rust #233. Authorize timing only after sealing the exact proposed release-like compiler binary and an independent matched parent. The prior draft's 24 pairs are excluded.
correctness_before_claim: Run original native private impl guard suite, ordinary-Rlib one-private-file and combined type/one-file regression, stable-file-order byte-offset-only and newline-only edits, exposed expansion-location controls, and warm versus genuinely fresh external caller references. Require the corrected driver to rebuild correctly or produce the same observed native output and diagnostics. Retain every failed/excluded prototype. The parent uses its independent cold reference; the corrected arm starts from empty target and build state. Build and test use the same arm-private state in sequence. Cargo and the linker receive the normal Ohm environment. The build command starts a fresh process on every invocation. strace and JSON output only occur outside timing.
design: Separate 12 paired blocks, six of each arm order independently shuffled, after a complete reverse edit. Seed 1953201 for plain cargo +ohm build, seed 1953202 for plain cargo +ohm test --no-run, both --locked --offline. Time only the Cargo command from inside the namespace. Perform a successful restored build between each edited measurement, and check first and last actual full/link-only rustcs and Wild processes per arm.
gates: All 501 or 619 units must be fresh on each immediate post-edit and post-restoration repetition, no registry compilation during scored edits, exactly changed/original Ruff diagnostic as appropriate, identical graph and expected 15/110 final ELF path sets. Preserve full output hashes independently of timing and repeat clean comparison for any eventual candidate. Any failed correctness or freshness guard blocks a claim.
analysis: Mean paired log ratio, arm medians, deterministic 20,000 paired bootstrap intervals; exact two-sided randomization over all 924 balanced schedules; Holm correction across the two endpoints at .05. Require a real reduction in full compiles on both independent traces for that endpoint. Report actual native link counts separately. No pilot contributes any sample.
